action.content:
A man performs for a crowd on a stage.
Bright lights shine on his face.

He begins singing a soft song.
His voice fills the large room.
A hush falls over the people.
He closes his eyes briefly.

Bass lines vibrate the floor.
He opens his eyes again.
He smiles at the front row.
Someone cheers loudly from the back.
He nods to the sound engineer.
The song tempo increases.
He starts moving his feet.
His energy grows with every note.
The crowd claps along.
He jumps slightly on the spot.
Sweat beads on his forehead.
He wipes it away quickly.
The guitar solo begins.
He steps back for the guitarist.
The crowd roars in approval.
He claps his hands overhead.
The guitarist finishes his part.
He steps forward to the mic.
He speaks to the audience.
They listen to his quiet words.
He tells a short funny story.
Laughter ripples through the hall.
He thanks them for coming.
The band launches the next track.
This song is much faster.
He runs across the stage floor.
He grabs a tambourine.
He shakes it with wild energy.
Lights flash in red and blue.

He looks like a ghost in fog.

He sings directly to her.

He hits a high note.
His voice cracks slightly.
He laughs at his mistake.
The crowd loves his honesty.
He takes a deep breath.
The music slows down again.
He sings the final verse softly.
Lights dim to a single spot.
He stands perfectly still.
The last chord rings out.
Silence hangs in the air.
Applause erupts suddenly.
He bows deeply to the crowd.
He waves to the left side.
He waves to the right side.
He blows a kiss to the front.
The band joins him on stage.
They all bow together.
He thanks the musicians loudly.
He thanks the crew behind scenes.
He thanks the audience one last time.
He walks off the stage slowly.
Lights fade to black.
The show is finally over.
He feels tired but happy.
The memory stays with him.
The crowd leaves the building.
They talk about the great night.
He goes to the dressing room.
He takes off his shoes.
He sits down on a chair.
He closes his eyes again.
He dreams of the next show.
